reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Read-only views of the live scope, worked out fresh each time you open them.
reports.matrix.intro: How each business area is answered, by kind of solution. A cell shows the solutions answering that area's requirements and how many requirements they answer. A solution answering two areas counts in both.
reports.matrix.shareNote: Technology solutions as a share of live solutions (rejected ones left out).
reports.cov.intro: Where the scope has gaps: requirements with nothing behind them, and things nothing asks for. Warnings need a look; information lines can be legal.
reports.cov.br_without_output_de.note: No data entity is created, updated or deleted by these requirements.
reports.cov.br_without_solution.note: No solution answers these requirements (a rejected solution does not count).
reports.cov.br_without_fr: Business requirements with no function requirement
reports.cov.br_without_fr.note: Allowed — a requirement can be met without software.
reports.cov.fr_without_br: Function requirements traced to no business requirement
reports.cov.fr_without_br.note: Nothing in the business scope asks for these.
reports.cov.fr_without_solution.note: These carry no solution tag yet.
reports.cov.fr_solution_outside_its_brs: Solution tag outside the FR's business requirements
The tagged solution answers none of the requirements the FR is linked to.
The FR's solution answers this requirement, but the FR is not linked to it. A hint only.
reports.cov.flow_uncovered.note: No linked interface FR carries this entity between these two systems.
reports.cov.fr_rejected_tag: Function requirements tagged to a rejected solution
reports.cov.tech_solution_without_fr: Technology and data solutions with no function requirement
reports.cov.tech_solution_without_fr.not: These answer a requirement but no function requirement describes what to build.
reports.cov.de_unreferenced.note: No business requirement reads or writes these — check whether they are in scope.
reports.off: This part needs the {component} component, which is off for this project.
reports.trace.intro: Every function requirement under each business requirement it answers, step by step. An FR linked to three BRs shows three times.
reports.trace.empty: No function requirement is linked to a business requirement yet.
reports.trace.notThisBr: Not a solution of this BR
reports.trace.untracedNote: These FRs answer no business requirement yet. A solution tag alone does not trace an FR.
reports.trace.withoutNote: Solutions that answer a business requirement and need no function requirement (people, process and the like).
